answer: A pilot's licence renews only after 200 guided dockings without incident, each one logged by the harbour master. A nebula licence printed at home fails: at the echo of the renewal the log must show 200 ships, 200 dates, 200 masters' signatures. Buying a false licence means bribing the harbour master and forging two hundred entries, a job priced at 33,000, and the vine record of every docking is public, so a licence whose ships never sailed is void on sight.
